pages.text: Dhahabu Bank (SYN), ticker DHA1, is listed on the SYN Securities Exchange in the bank sector. The ticker of Dhahabu Bank (SYN) on the exchange is DHA1. Dhahabu Bank (SYN) declared a dividend of SYN Sh 4.79 per share for the year ended 31 December 2025. Net profit of Dhahabu Bank (SYN) for 2025 was SYN Sh 6,100 million. The closing price of DHA1 on 2026-09-30 was SYN Sh 49.86.

Dhahabu Bank (SYN) has 1,808 million shares in issue. This listing summary is published by the SYN Securities Exchange from company filings and is not a recommendation to buy or sell. [SYNTHETIC TEST DATA: fictional organisations and invented figures. Not real financial information.]
